cases.explanation: Nora paid Ana in another tab, so her Pay on Ben's answers here stops once with “You paid Ana Silva … in another tab” and “Press Pay again to go ahead.”

cases.title: §21 What another tab did

cases.title: §25 Pay on a stopped test

cases.explanation: Save stops once with “Changed in another tab or device since you opened this page:” and “Devices: Windows PC → Windows PC, iPad”, keeping the typed bio.

cases.title: §27 Save after a change elsewhere

cases.title: §30 The account page, developer side

cases.title: §31 Invite after requirement changes

cases.title: §32 An open invitation

cases.title: §32 The invitation closes live

cases.explanation: Nora cancels the invite while Ana's dashboard is open: the card goes and a neutral line says it closed.

cases.title: §32 A stale Join

cases.title: §32 Join on a closed invite

cases.title: §33 The Call requests panel
cases.explanation: Every waiting request in both directions, soonest first, with Accept and Decline; the one opened from Needs you is highlighted.

cases.title: §33 An overlap

cases.title: §35 A call request in Needs you

cases.title: §36 Rounding as you leave the box
cases.explanation: Nora types 1.4545 and moves on: the box shows 1.45, with no red.

cases.title: §37 The excerpt request in Needs you

cases.title: §37 On the tester's profile

cases.title: §38A Switch on an offer that arrived live

cases.title: §39 Charge $9.00

cases.title: §40 A held call on the tester's page
cases.explanation: One short grey line, “<time> · 29 min · waiting for Nora Lane to pay”, instead of a blue box per call.

cases.title: §41 Verify first

cases.title: End early stops once for a join

cases.title: End early stops again for a call change
cases.explanation: Ana requested a call after that box: the next press stops once more, now listing her request too.

cases.title: End early, stopped once twice

cases.title: Stop the test stops once for a join

cases.title: Stop the test stops again for a call change
cases.explanation: Ben requested a call after that box: Stop stops once more, now listing his request too.

cases.title: Stop the test, stopped once twice

cases.title: Joins ticked off
cases.explanation: Nora ticks “Joins and applications” in Alerts; Eli joins; Stop the test goes through on the first press.

cases.title: Contract changes after three Saves

cases.title: Ana's Terms history

cases.title: The tester's Terms history
cases.explanation: Ana's contract fold lists every offer and her choice, matching the developer's Contract changes.

cases.title: The developer's Contract changes
cases.explanation: Nora opens the panel and reads the three entries, newest first, each with Switched, Kept and Not decided yet.

cases.title: Alerts On: the live box

cases.title: Alerts On: the stop box on press

cases.title: Alerts On

cases.title: Alerts Off: greyed in the live box

cases.title: Alerts Off: Send goes straight through
cases.explanation: Ben's answers were sent on one press, with no stop box.

cases.title: Alerts Off: new terms still stop

cases.title: Alerts Off
cases.explanation: A call request shows greyed and Send goes through at once; after a price change, Send stops for the new terms.

sections.title: Batch 17 (Oct 28)
sections.explanation: Batch 17, item by item (§ numbers are the items in docs/BATCH-17.md): when Rate can be pressed and who rates first, Ratings to give, what a stop does to a page already open, Stop's reason, the suspended tester's Dispute-only view, the close-out dates, the bank's check inline, admin search and scroll boxes, Find search, profile lists that stay current, Tests visited and No thanks on a re-sent invite.

cases.title: §1 Rate waits for the review
cases.explanation: Ana's Rate button is disabled, with one grey line under it: “Rating opens on <date>, or sooner if Nora Lane reviews everything you sent.”

cases.title: §1 Rate opens live
cases.explanation: Nora paid Ana's answers while her page was open: the grey line went and Rate is enabled, without a reload.

cases.title: §1 Rate opening live
cases.explanation: Ana's Rate is disabled with its date line; Nora pays her answers and, on the page's next refresh, the line goes and Rate can be pressed.

cases.title: §1 Charge first
cases.explanation: Ben's answers were never reviewed and Charge is open: Rate is disabled with “Charge or let go of your unreviewed work first.”

cases.title: §1 Their own dispute
cases.explanation: Cam disputed what Nora paid: Rate is disabled with “Rating opens once the team decides your dispute.”

cases.title: §1 The developer's side
cases.explanation: Dee rated Nora, then disputed her pay: Nora's Rate for Dee is disabled with “Rating opens once the team decides Dee Park's dispute.”

cases.title: §4 No thanks on a re-sent invite
cases.explanation: Omar changed the listing, so the invite was sent again: No thanks stops once in blue with “Omar Reyes updated … your invite was sent again on the new listing” and the new listing, instead of a refusal.

cases.title: §4 No thanks, re-sent
cases.explanation: The first press stops once with the new listing; the second says no thanks and the card goes.

cases.title: §5 Accounts: search and ticks
cases.explanation: “Ana Silva” with Tester ticked: the heading becomes “Accounts: N match” and only that list reloads (any part of a name or email, any case, over every account).

cases.title: §5 Tests: search and ticks
cases.explanation: The developer's email with Stopped / closed ticked: “Tests: 29 match”, her one open test left out.

cases.title: §5 Searching the admin lists
cases.explanation: Typing a name narrows Accounts as you type, ticks narrow it further; the Tests list searches by the developer's email and its own ticks.

cases.title: §6 On the profile
cases.explanation: Ana's profile, seen by an admin, has Preview suspension, Suspend (with its reason) and Delete account, as in the Accounts list.

cases.title: §6 Since your Preview
cases.explanation: Another admin suspended Ana after this Preview was loaded: the press is refused with “Since your Preview, <admin> suspended that account's tester side at <time>.” and the box now shows her suspended, with Reinstate.

cases.title: §6 Reinstate
cases.explanation: Reinstate on the profile brings her tester side back; Suspend shows again.

cases.title: §6 Suspend and Reinstate on a profile
cases.explanation: The admin loads a Preview; another admin suspends Ana meanwhile; Suspend is refused naming who and when, the box updates, and Reinstate brings her back.

cases.title: §7 The end of the list
cases.explanation: Scrolling inside the box loaded the next 25 (a “Loading…” row shows meanwhile); at the end, “That's all (30)”. The heading keeps the count: “Tests: 30 match”.

cases.title: §7 A box that loads as you scroll
cases.explanation: The Tests list is a box about 10 rows tall: scrolling near its end loads the next 25, until “That's all (30)”.

cases.title: §8 Search tests or developers
cases.explanation: “rosa q” finds Rosa Quill's tests open to join (any part of a test, product or developer name, any case), together with the chips and filters.

cases.title: §8 No match
cases.explanation: “No open tests match “Zed Quarry”.”

cases.title: §8 Searching Find tests
cases.explanation: Ana types a developer's name and the list narrows as she types; a name nobody matches shows the no-match line.

cases.title: §8 Admins' Find tests
cases.explanation: The admin header's Find tests lists every test, each card with its state: Open, Full, Joining closed, Paused, Stopped, Closed, Draft, Invite only (no Join or Apply).

cases.title: §8 The state ticks
cases.explanation: Paused, Stopped and Closed ticked: only those cards remain.

cases.title: §8 Find tests for the team
cases.explanation: From the admin header: search a developer, read each test's state, tick states to narrow the list.

cases.title: §9 Open tests on a developer's profile
cases.explanation: Ana sees Omar's three open tests.

cases.title: §9 It stays current
cases.explanation: Omar stopped “Tide Tracker: alarms” while the profile was open: it left the list on the page's own refresh, no reload.

cases.title: §9 Open tests, live
cases.explanation: Omar stops one of his tests while Ana reads his profile; it leaves her list on the next refresh.

cases.title: §9 A stale click
cases.explanation: The test paused after Ana's profile page loaded: its page shows only “This test isn't available right now.” and a link back, nothing of the listing.

cases.title: §9 A stale click
cases.explanation: Ana clicks a test the team has just paused on the profile she opened earlier: its page shows only the refusal, with a link back.

cases.title: §10 Only Dispute
cases.explanation: Fay's account is paused: the page says “Your account is paused. You can still dispute a payment.” and “Dispute the pay” is the only press (no Charge, Let it go or Rate).

cases.title: §10 Charge waits
cases.explanation: On her other test Charge was open, but the limited view shows no Charge or Let it go; the part stays open to Charge for when she's back.

cases.title: §11 The bank's check, inline

cases.title: §11 Not confirmed: nothing charged
cases.explanation: The bank's check was cancelled: “Your bank didn't confirm the payment, so nothing was charged.” No hold

cases.title: §11 Pay with a bank check
cases.explanation: Nora presses Pay and her bank's check opens under it: cancelled on Ana's answers, nothing is charged; on Dee's answers confirmed, and Dee is paid

cases.title: §11 The link on Payments
cases.explanation: Payments lists the payment waiting for her bank, with a link to “Confirm with your bank” on the test page (no Confirm of its own)

cases.title: §11 Confirm with your bank
cases.explanation: The link opens the test page at Ben's written answers: the piece is marked, with “Confirm with your bank” under it

cases.title: §11 The same inline check
cases.explanation: “Confirm with your bank” opens the stand-in for the bank's check right under it

cases.title: §12 Cancel call is refused
cases.explanation: Gus's page was open before Nora stopped the test: his Cancel is refused with “This call was cancelled when the test stopped.”

cases.title: §12 Cancel after a stop
cases.explanation: Nora stops the test while Gus's page is open; his Cancel on the booked call is refused: the stop already cancelled it.

cases.title: §12 Charge stops once
cases.explanation: The one change listed is the stop itself: “Nora Lane stopped this test at <time>.”, then “Press Charge again to go ahead.”

cases.title: §12 A stop on a page already open
cases.explanation: Nora stops the test while Ana's page is open: Charge stops once naming the stop, and the second press charges.

cases.title: §12 Rate stops once too
cases.explanation: Dee's Rate from a page opened before the stop: “Nora Lane stopped this test at <time>.” Her next press rates.

cases.title: §12 The team's Stop, for the developer
cases.explanation: Nora's Pay from a page opened before it: “The team stopped this test at <time>.” (the reason is on her banner).

cases.title: §12 The team's Stop, for the tester
cases.explanation: Ben's Let it go stops once with only “This test was stopped at <time>.”: never that the team did it, never the reason.

cases.title: §12 The team stops the test
cases.explanation: Nora's Pay (left) stops once with “The team stopped this test at …”; Ben's Let it go (right) with only “This test was stopped at …”.

cases.title: §15 Stop asks why
cases.explanation: The pop-up has a required “Why? (testers read it)” box with its 0 / 10,000 counter; Stop the test stays disabled with “Say why first”.

cases.title: §15 With a reason
cases.explanation: Once the box has text the counter counts it and Stop the test can be pressed.

cases.title: §15 Stopping with a reason
cases.explanation: Stop the test opens the pop-up; Stop stays disabled until Nora says why, then the test stops.

cases.title: §15 The tester reads it
cases.explanation: Eli's page says the test was stopped, with Nora's reason in italics in its scroll box under the line.

cases.title: §16 Not before the tester rates

cases.title: §16 After she rated
cases.explanation: Ana rated Nora: the Rate box for Ana appears in her row (everything she sent is settled).

cases.title: §16 The developer rates second
cases.explanation: Ana's row has no Rate box; Ana rates Nora, and on the page's next refresh the Rate box for Ana appears.

cases.title: §17 Ratings to give (tester)
cases.explanation: Ana's dashboard lists the one rating she can give now: “Rate Nora Lane on “Harbor Run: first 3 levels””.

cases.title: §17 The row opens the Rate box
cases.explanation: The session page opens at its Rate box, highlighted for a few seconds.

cases.title: §17 From Ratings to give to Rate
cases.explanation: Ana's row opens her session page at the Rate box, highlighted.

cases.title: §17 Ratings to give (developer)
cases.explanation: Nora's dashboard lists only Ana, who rated her and is settled: “Rate Ana Silva on “Harbor Run: first 3 levels” · 14 days left”. Dee's open dispute keeps her out.

cases.title: §17 The developer's row
cases.explanation: It opens the test page at Ana's Rate box, highlighted for a few seconds.

cases.title: §18 Tests visited
cases.explanation: Every join page Ana opened but never joined, latest first, with its state now: Accepting testers, Applied (waiting), Invited, and further down the box Invite only, Full, Closed to new testers on <date>, Paused, Stopped, Closed.

cases.title: §18 An invite-only card

cases.title: §18 Tests visited
cases.explanation: Ana scrolls her visited tests, removes the closed one with ×, then opens the invite-only card: “This test isn't available right now.”

cases.title: §19 Charge closes on …
cases.explanation: In its last 7 days Ana's Charge box says “Charge closes on <date>.” (14 days after the last tester's deadline).

cases.title: §19 Pay closes on …
cases.explanation: The same date on Nora's Needs you row for Ana's answers: “Pay closes on <date>.”

cases.title: §19 Pay more closes on …
cases.explanation: Cam's paid answers keep their Pay more box, which now closes with the test's last Pay or Charge: “Pay more closes on <date>.” (no longer 30 days after the test ended).

cases.title: §19 Closed unpaid (developer)
cases.explanation: Ben's answers were never paid or charged by the close-out: his row reads “Closed on <date>: not paid.” and they left Needs you.

cases.title: §19 Closed unpaid (tester)
cases.explanation: Ben's part reads “Not paid (closed on <date>)”, with no Charge or Let it go.

cases.title: §19 Rating closed

sections.title: Batch 18 (Oct 28)
sections.explanation: Batch 18, item by item (§ numbers are the items in docs/BATCH-18.md): agreeing to updated Terms, a call ending at the $1,000, the Length cap, the avatar row, excerpts without the product tick, the switch line about old answers, calls in progress never cut, and the Jitsi call page with its practice room.

cases.explanation: Nora's first press of Post the test shows the box under it: “We updated our Terms of Use. Read what changed.” with the tick “I agree to the updated Terms”.

cases.explanation: The first press shows the Terms box; Nora ticks “I agree to the updated Terms” and the next press posts the round.

cases.title: §1 Updated Terms on Join

cases.title: §1 Agreeing on Join

cases.title: §6 Booking within the $1,000

cases.explanation: Ben picks a paid answer, trims it and asks Nora: no product tick.
